Appreciate it — I’ll loop back when finance completes the check.

Best,

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the docs. I’ll take point on bank verification. Quick notes on our process so you know what to expect: 

1) Vendor enrollment validation: we confirm the account via ACH micro-deposit OR bank letter (either is fine) — if you opt for micro-deposit we’ll post two small amounts to the account and ask you to confirm the exact amounts. Timeline: typically 1–3 business days after we initiate.

2) Remittance mapping: we will store the remittance email (accounts.payable@taxonix.ai) and map the payment reference field. Redwood payment processing prefers a single alphanumeric reference; the suggested format PO53421:INV1023 is acceptable. Please confirm whether you require the colon or a hyphen (both workable).

3) Required attachments to finalize: W-9 (received), completed vendor enrollment form (I attached our Vendor Enrollment Checklist to this reply for your convenience). If there are any corporate ACH blocks on your side, please let us know so we can use wire instead.

I’ve attached Vendor_Enrollment_Checklist.pdf (checklist) and have linked the PO record in our system: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Taxonix/onboarding/53421.

Once confirmed, we’ll create the payment instruction and update PO-53421 to ‘Ready for payment’ status.

Thanks — I’ll start the verification now and will update the thread when the micro-deposit posts.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

I’ve uploaded a bank letter to the Drive link for completeness (same folder as the W-9) in case you prefer that over micro-deposit. For speed, feel free to proceed with a micro-deposit; we’ll confirm the amounts as soon as they come through.

We’ll also send a short remittance file (CSV) on invoice to accounts.payable@taxonix.ai when invoices go out — columns: invoice_number, date, net_amount, PO_reference. Please confirm if you need a different remittance mapping.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to getting PO-53421 into the queue.

Best,
